title: The AI Engineer Move Most People Skip
description:
If you're going to be an AI engineer, you might as well use AI tools to multiply your own output. Cursor, Claude Code, whatever you like, build your own skills and build your own agents. This doesn't just make you faster, it teaches you how these systems actually behave, which makes you better at building your own. 

And then the last piece is preparing for the interview. Easy to conceptualize, not easy to do: expect a little LeetCode, a little system design, and some AI-specific domain questions or exercises they'll want you to work through.

#techwithtim #aiengineer #ai #programming
